name: LoraxBench
intro: LoraxBench 是面向印尼语及 19 种印度尼西亚本地语言的综合基准，覆盖阅读理解、开放域问答、自然语言推断、机器翻译、因果推理和文化问答六项任务。三种本地语言分别提供正式与日常语域，共形成 23 个语言/语域子集。六条任务支路来自 TyDi-QA、IndoNLI、COPAL-ID 与 IndoCulture；论文仅对开放问答、因果推理和文化问答描述了各自的来源专属清理。五类非翻译任务保留印尼语原始记录，专业双语母语者另行翻译出 22 个本地语言/语域版本，并由第二位母语者逐条复核、配合长度与数字一致性脚本检查。
build_method: 并行改造六类印尼语源任务（开放问答、因果推理与文化问答按论文分别清理）, 五类非翻译任务保留印尼语原始记录, 专业双语母语者翻译22个本地版本, 第二母语者逐条复核, 脚本辅助检查及确认错误重译
metric: 准确率（开放问答采用标准答案子串匹配）, ChrF++; 附录另做 Gemini-2.5-Flash 评审敏感性分析
language: 印尼语及19种本地语言（23个语言/语域子集）
task_type: 选择题, 开放式问答, 自然语言推理, 翻译, 分类
eval_feature: 多语言, 语域对比, 本土文化
scale: 84,711条测试 + 2,300条MCQA训练 = 官方发布87,011行
task_type_en: Multiple Choice, Open-ended QA, Natural Language Inference, Translation, Classification
build_method_en: Parallel adaptation of six Indonesian-source tasks (with paper-specified cleanup for Open QA, causal reasoning, and cultural QA), retention of Indonesian originals for the five non-translation tasks, professional translation into 22 local variants, second-speaker review, scripted checks, and re-translation of confirmed errors
intro_en: LoraxBench is a comprehensive benchmark for Indonesian and 19 regional Indonesian languages across reading comprehension, open-domain QA, natural language inference, machine translation, causal reasoning, and cultural QA. Formal and casual variants for three local languages yield 23 language/register subsets. Its six task branches come from TyDi-QA, IndoNLI, COPAL-ID, and IndoCulture; the paper describes source-specific cleanup only for Open QA, causal reasoning, and cultural QA. The five non-translation tasks retain their Indonesian records, while professional bilingual native speakers translate 22 local language/register variants for per-record review by a second native speaker and script-assisted length/numeric checks.
language_en: Indonesian and 19 local languages (23 language/register subsets)
scale_en: 84,711 test rows + 2,300 MCQA training rows = 87,011 rows in the official release
metric_en: Accuracy (gold-answer substring match for Open QA), ChrF++; appendix Gemini-2.5-Flash judge sensitivity analysis

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against the only arXiv version, 2508.12459v1 (submitted 2025-08-17; reviewed PDF SHA256 2fe3ba0e22358501f0a861a5ee7dead31772d579acbbdd14d785aca032a6233e), and the official google/LoraxBench Hugging Face dataset pinned at commit 1ebe2dac146872e4fbad982f9d0102f140b7e3ff (2025-08-03). The seven pinned Parquet files independently verify the six task branches and counts: TyDi-QA reading comprehension has 564 test plus 100 train records for each of 23 subsets; Open QA removes context and six manually identified unanswerable questions, leaving 558 per subset; expert-written single-sentence IndoNLI NLI has 1,446 per subset; machine translation reuses 251 IndoNLI premises for 22 non-Indonesian source language/register variants with Indonesian targets; filtered COPAL-ID has 365 per subset; and cleaned non-province IndoCulture has 510 per subset after 61 removals, 12 typo fixes, and 13 distractor improvements. The original Indonesian records are retained for the five non-translation tasks. Professional annotators native in Indonesian and the corresponding local language translate the task material into 22 local language/register variants; every translated entry is reviewed by another native speaker, Google Sheets scripts flag length and numeric anomalies, confirmed errors are re-translated, and meetings resolve inconsistencies. Count provenance is intentionally not collapsed: paper Table 3 sums to 84,711 test rows, section 3.5 states 84,895 without reconciliation, and the HF release contains the same 84,711 test rows plus 2,300 MCQA training rows, totaling 87,011. The paper evaluates all six tasks zero-shot and additionally explores few-shot reading comprehension; it specifies basic, language-informed, GATITOS lexicon, generation/extraction, open-model choice-log-probability, and causal/cultural cloze modes, then reports the maximum across prompts. Metrics are accuracy for five non-translation tasks, ChrF++ for translation, and gold-answer substring matching for Open QA; Appendix D also studies a Gemini-2.5-Flash 1-5 judge normalized by 5. The public repository boundary is explicit: the pinned HF revision provides CC BY 4.0 data and README only, with no construction/evaluation code, upstream source revisions, selection seeds, decoding configuration, few-shot k/sampling rule, or exact parser implementation beyond the paper text.
